clauses: This prominent university teacher and nuclear physicist made groundbreaking contributions to the physical sciences.
Throughout their distinguished career, they received numerous honors for their work, including the Matteucci Medal, the Franklin Medal, and an invitation to deliver the Guthrie Lecture.
They were also recognized as an Honorary Fellow of the Royal Society Te Apārangi.
However, despite their monumental legacy in science, they were never awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry.
